PART VII: 43. The  currency  of  Sri  Lanka  shall  be  the  Sri  Lanka
rupee. The Sri Lanka rupee shall be divided into one hundred
units each of which shall be called a “cent”.

44.
The  Central  Bank  shall  have  the  sole  right  and
authority to issue currency in Sri Lanka.
